meta.selector_attribute: data-fsm (conceptual: this run drives replays by accessibility label / visible text; see run.json adaptation_record — no selector attributes ship in the app)

conformance.command: n/a — RN app driven manually via react-native-web lane

graded.command: n/a — store build; no graded environment exists

landing_sign_in.name: Tap the Sign in pill
landing_sign_in.observable_result: The Authentication screen replaces the landing page.

landing_open_loki.name: Tap Open Loki (signed out)
landing_open_loki.observable_result: Signed out, the Authentication screen opens with returnTo=/dashboard/browse; signed in, Browse opens directly.

landing_scroll_how.name: Tap 'How it works' in the nav
landing_scroll_how.observable_result: The page scrolls to the 'Four steps between here and out the door.' section.

landing_footer_explore.name: Tap Explore Loki in the footer
landing_footer_explore.observable_result: Same as Open Loki: Authentication when signed out, Browse when signed in.

landing_footer_about.name: Tap About in the footer legal row

landing_footer_privacy.name: Tap Privacy in the footer legal row

landing_footer_cookies.name: Tap Cookies in the footer legal row

auth_sign_in.name: Sign in (returning user)
auth_sign_in.observable_result: FullPageLoader plays, then Browse renders with the user's greeting name.

auth_sign_up.name: Create an account (new user)
auth_sign_up.observable_result: A users/{email} document is created and the onboarding quiz opens.

onboarding_advance.name: Advance one onboarding step
onboarding_advance.observable_result: The next step renders and the progress bar fills one segment.

onboarding_skip.name: Skip the quiz
onboarding_skip.observable_result: Browse renders without a budget parameter.

onboarding_finish.name: Finish the quiz (Start exploring)
onboarding_finish.observable_result: Browse renders, carrying the chosen budget as a parameter.

browse_toggle_search.name: Toggle the search field
browse_toggle_search.observable_result: The search input expands under the header (or collapses).

browse_search.name: Type a search query
browse_search.observable_result: The place grid filters to names matching the query.

browse_open_chat.name: Open the Ask Loki chat sheet
browse_open_chat.observable_result: The Ask Loki sheet slides in with suggested prompts.

chat_send.name: Send a chat message

gui_procedure.text: Chill spots to work with coffee

chat_send.observable_result: Loki replies with markdown text and recommendation cards on a mini map.

browse_explore_group.name: Open an explore group
browse_explore_group.observable_result: Sub-filter pills and result rows for the group render.

browse_open_vibe.name: Open a curated vibe album
browse_open_vibe.observable_result: The vibe drill-down grid replaces the default sections.

browse_vibe_grid_open_place.name: Open a place from the vibe grid
browse_vibe_grid_open_place.observable_result: The place details sheet opens over the grid.

browse_open_place.name: Open a place from Today's picks
browse_open_place.observable_result: The place details sheet opens with hero image and action buttons.

place_close_sheet.name: Close the place details sheet
place_close_sheet.observable_result: The sheet dismisses and the browse content is visible again.

place_open_collection_selector.name: Open the add-to-collection drawer
place_open_collection_selector.observable_result: A bottom drawer lists the user's collections with checkmarks.

place_toggle_collection.name: Add the place to a collection
place_toggle_collection.observable_result: The row shows a checkmark and a toast reads 'Added to collection'.

browse_quick_quiz.name: Quick access: Quiz
browse_quick_quiz.observable_result: The onboarding quiz opens at step 1.

browse_see_all_vibes.name: See all vibes
browse_see_all_vibes.observable_result: The vibe picker page opens (bottom nav hidden there, as on the web).

browse_nav_maps.name: Pill nav: Maps
browse_nav_maps.observable_result: The Maps tab becomes active (MapPin icon brightens).

browse_nav_collections.name: Pill nav: Collections
browse_nav_collections.observable_result: The Collections tab becomes active (Library icon brightens).

browse_nav_profile.name: Pill nav: Profile
browse_nav_profile.observable_result: The Profile tab becomes active (User icon brightens).

vibes_select.name: Select a vibe
vibes_select.observable_result: The row shows a check icon and a stronger border; Apply enables.

vibes_apply.name: Apply the selected vibe
vibes_apply.observable_result: Browse renders in the vibe drill-down state for the chosen vibe.

vibes_back.name: Back from the vibe picker
vibes_back.observable_result: Browse renders in its previous state.

maps_dismiss_interstitial.name: Dismiss the maps interstitial (Let's go)
maps_dismiss_interstitial.observable_result: The interstitial fades and the live map is interactive.

maps_expand_sheet.name: Drag the bottom sheet up
maps_expand_sheet.observable_result: The sheet expands to ~88% height showing the browse list.

maps_open_filters.name: Open the filters drawer
maps_open_filters.observable_result: The filter tray opens with popups-only, 21+, budget and category controls.

maps_toggle_popups.name: Toggle popups-only
maps_toggle_popups.observable_result: Markers filter down to active limited-time popups (red pulse).

maps_area_search.name: Search an area (geocode)
maps_area_search.observable_result: The map flies to the area and a toast confirms the move.

maps_select_place.name: Tap a place marker
maps_select_place.observable_result: The marker gains the rose ring and a popup card appears; tapping it opens place details.

maps_hotspot.name: Shuffle to the next hotspot
maps_hotspot.observable_result: The camera eases to the next hotspot (Downtown, Marina, JBR, ...).

maps_nav_browse.name: Pill nav: Browse (from Maps)
maps_nav_browse.observable_result: Browse renders; the Home icon brightens.

collections_open_create.name: Open the create-collection dialog
collections_open_create.observable_result: The 'Make new collection ✨' dialog opens with a name input.

collections_create.name: Create the collection
collections_create.observable_result: The dialog closes, a toast reads 'Collection created!', and a new gradient card appears.

collections_open_detail.name: Open a collection
collections_open_detail.observable_result: The full-screen collection detail view opens with banner collage.

collections_nav_browse.name: Pill nav: Browse (from Collections)
collections_nav_browse.observable_result: Browse renders; the Home icon brightens.

collection_share.name: Generate a share link
collection_share.observable_result: A share URL is produced and copy/share actions appear.

detail_open_share_link.name: Open the generated share link
detail_open_share_link.observable_result: The shared collection page renders for the token.

collection_delete_open.name: Open the delete confirmation
collection_delete_open.observable_result: An alert dialog asks to confirm deleting the collection.

collection_delete.name: Confirm delete
collection_delete.observable_result: The list renders without the deleted collection.

collection_collaborators.name: Open the collaborator manager
collection_collaborators.observable_result: The collaborator pane opens with an email input.

collab_add.name: Add a collaborator
collab_add.observable_result: The collaborator chip appears in the members row.

collab_remove.name: Remove a collaborator
collab_remove.observable_result: The collaborator chip disappears from the members row.

detail_remove_place.name: Remove a place from the lineup
detail_remove_place.observable_result: The place card leaves the lineup and the count decrements.

collection_vote.name: Swipe-vote yes on a place
collection_vote.observable_result: The card flies right with a YES stamp and the next card surfaces.

collection_decide_results.name: Open the decide results pane
collection_decide_results.observable_result: Winner cards and the leaderboard render with vote counts.

detail_open_map.name: Open the collection map overlay
detail_open_map.observable_result: A fullscreen map shows the collection's places as thumbnail markers.

detail_close_map.name: Close the collection map overlay
detail_close_map.observable_result: The detail view is visible again.

profile_sign_out.name: Sign out
profile_sign_out.observable_result: The Authentication page renders and a toast reads 'Signed out'.

profile_booking_open.name: Open the Add booking dialog
profile_booking_open.observable_result: The 'When did you book it for?' dialog opens with place/date/time fields.

profile_booking_add.name: Save a booking reminder
profile_booking_add.observable_result: The dialog closes, a toast reads 'Booking saved — add it to your calendar to get reminded', an .ics downloads, and the row appears under Calendar.

profile_booking_remove.name: Remove a booking reminder
profile_booking_remove.observable_result: The row disappears and a toast reads 'Booking removed'.

shared_guest_identity.name: Set guest name and emoji
shared_guest_identity.observable_result: The dialog closes and the guest appears in the crew row.

shared_expand_place.name: Expand a place card
shared_expand_place.observable_result: The card expands with tags and map/website links.

shared_vote.name: Swipe-vote yes (shared)
shared_vote.observable_result: The vote lands on the leaderboard and persists across reload.

shared_add_places_open.name: Open the add-places dialog
shared_add_places_open.observable_result: A dialog lists searchable places with filter chips.

shared_add_places.name: Add selected places (editor)
shared_add_places.observable_result: The new places render in the grid for every viewer.

shared_save.name: Save to my collections
shared_save.observable_result: A toast confirms the save and the collection appears in the viewer's Collections.

shared_go_home.name: Go home from a shared collection

about_open_app.name: About CTA back to the landing

goals.description: A users/{email} document exists for the newly signed-up account, created through the product UI.
A new collection exists in the owner's users doc.
The selected place is inside the chosen collection's places array.
A sharedCollections document exists for the shared collection.
Exactly one yes vote by the voter exists on the shared collection.
A booking reminder row exists in users.bookings.
The shared collection is saved into the viewer's own collections.
